exists.description: Whether an account is registered under this e-mail.

emailVerified.description: Present only when the account exists — false means the client should resume the e-mail verification flow instead of asking for a password.

hasPassword.description: Present only when the account exists — false means an OAuth-only sign-up, so the client should point at the social sign-in instead of a password field.

description: Routing signals for the unified "sign in or create account" surface: sign-up, resume-verification, OAuth-only or password step.
